constraints: Source-bound edit only: retain original slide geometry, order, relationships, imagery, theme, and assets. No shape may move, resize, or reflow.
Exact text-binding cardinality is preserved; each semantic slot retains ordered existing text bindings.
Footer, legal line, and slide number remain source-bound and are excluded from editable slots.
Text fit and capacity are unmeasured; source character counts are not capacity claims.
Native PowerPoint rendering and visual QA remain separate qualification gates.
